name: Sofia - school bus, cats and teenage bedroom
initial_ai_searchtext:
Home search requirements:
No preferences provided yet.

turns.message: I need to move quite quickly. I’m British, one adult with two kids, looking for 3 or 4 bedrooms. Ideally partially furnished with white goods. Budget max RM7,800 and move-in 1 October.
The children go to Alice Smith and I don't want to drive them to a bus stop. A 10–15 minute walk to a stop is okay.
TTDI would actually be my favourite area if it works for school.
One thing I really don't want is a unit looking over a car park. What would you recommend for us now?

preference_checks.description: walk 10–15 minutes to the school bus stop without driving

name: New expat family searching broadly
initial_ai_searchtext:
Home search requirements:
No preferences provided yet.

synthetic_persona.identity: You are part of a family relocating to Kuala Lumpur. Your spouse and children will live with you. You do not know the KL rental market particularly well and want an agent to help you work out where and what to rent.
true_requirements: family of four: 2 adults and 2 children
budget approximately RM10,000/month and can stretch to RM12,000 for something particularly good
synthetic_persona.behaviour: Start naturally by saying approximately that your family is moving to KL and needs somewhere to live. Do not dump all requirements initially. Reveal them naturally when useful questions are asked and judge recommendations honestly.

name: Renter refining recommendations
initial_ai_searchtext:
Home search requirements:
No preferences provided yet.

synthetic_persona.identity: You are an expat renter who already understands Kuala Lumpur reasonably well and wants help narrowing suitable properties.
true_requirements: does not want a unit overlooking a car park
open to more than one condo if compelling
synthetic_persona.behaviour: Start with the major requirements without necessarily revealing every secondary preference. At a natural point reveal the strong dislike of car-park views. Reject unsuitable recommendations honestly, explain why when natural, and ask useful follow-up questions about promising options.

name: Specific condo and search-scope customer
initial_ai_searchtext:
Home search requirements:
No preferences provided yet.

synthetic_persona.identity: You are already looking at specific Kuala Lumpur properties and use Rentee to explore actual available options. You expect an agent to follow immediate requests precisely.
true_requirements: interested specifically in DC Residensi during part of the conversation
willing to consider other suitable properties only when you ask for alternatives
synthetic_persona.behaviour: Begin with a normal property-search request. During the conversation naturally ask what about DC Residensi, then explicitly ask to see units in DC Residensi. Treat that as a genuine scoped search. If none suit, react naturally; ask for alternatives later only if you genuinely choose to.
